summary: Frontend-only verification of the new ImageWeightPanel in the Admin /admin Mirror DB tab. Admin login works, the panel renders with data-testid='image-weight-panel', the stats grid shows real numeric values for all 5 stat tiles, and the Refresh/Actualizar button re-fetches stats successfully. The Re-comprimir todo confirm/cancel toggle could NOT be exercised dynamically because a re-warm background job is currently running, which puts the recompress button in disabled state (disabled={warming}) and shows 'Re-comprimiendo…' instead of opening the confirm dialog. This is the expected behavior per the agent-to-agent context note. The code logic for the toggle (setConfirming true/false) was reviewed and is correctly implemented in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.jsx (lines 1184-1203).

verified_behavior.mirror_db_tab: PASS - tab button found and opened
verified_behavior.image-weight-stats: PASS - grid rendered with all stat tiles
verified_behavior.iw-avg-avif: PASS - shows '45 KB' with savings sub-text '~90% más ligero que el original'
verified_behavior.iw-variant-count: PASS - shows '365' (increased to 377 after refresh, confirming live re-fetch)
verified_behavior.iw-cache-size: PASS - shows '19.2 MB' (then '19.7 MB' after refresh)
verified_behavior.iw-settings: PASS - shows 'AVIF q55 · WebP q80' with warm settings sub-text
verified_behavior.image-weight-refresh-btn: PASS - re-fetched stats, variant count and cache size updated (365→377, 19.2→19.7 MB), no errors
verified_behavior.recompress-all-btn: PRESENT but DISABLED because stats.warm.running=true (re-warm in progress at 1.4%). force-clicking did not open confirm dialog because the button has disabled attribute. This matches the request note that 'A re-warm background job may currently be running, which is expected.'
verified_behavior.recompress-confirm-btn / recompress-canc: NOT DYNAMICALLY TESTED due to disabled state of parent button. Code review confirms the toggle is implemented correctly: setConfirming(true) on recompress-all-btn click → renders confirm + cancel; setConfirming(false) on cancel hides them; recompress() on confirm POSTs /api/admin/recompress-all and also setConfirming(false).

action_items: Optional: To allow QA of the confirm/cancel toggle while a warm is already running, consider a small UX tweak where the confirm dialog can still be opened (preview) but the actual 'Sí, re-comprimir' confirm is what gets disabled while warming. Today the whole open-confirm button is disabled, which means the toggle UI is unreachable during a warm run. Not a bug, just a testability/UX consideration.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is 3128 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Should be split into multiple files (one panel per file).
ImageWeightPanel.tokenHeader() reads localStorage on every render; this is fine but a useCallback could memoize.
fetchStats swallows errors silently in catch (/* transient */) — during long warm runs this is ok, but a brief retry indicator could help observability.
Tailwind via CDN warning in console: 'cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production.' — pre-existing issue, not specific to this feature.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (5/6 explicit checks fully verified; confirm/cancel toggle blocked by legitimate disabled state during active warm)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Mirror DB tab now contains the new ImageWeightPanel. All stat data-testids render numeric values from GET /api/admin/image-cache/stats. The recompress-all-btn is gated by stats.warm.running; to test the confirm/cancel toggle dynamically, wait until the current re-warm finishes (poll GET /api/admin/image-cache/stats and look for warm.running===false) before re-running the toggle test. The button onClick is wired to setConfirming(true), and cancel sets it back to false.
rca of the issue: Not a bug. The recompress-all-btn was rendered with disabled=warming where warming = stats.warm.running || busy. At test time, a background re-warm was in progress (~1.4% of 4414 images), so the button stayed disabled and the click did not toggle the confirm panel. This is expected per request context.
